title: Sharp mass-energy inequality
question: For the fourth-order cubic–quintic energy, find the best constant in the inequality controlling the focusing quartic term by mass, dispersion, and sextic energy.

title: Ground-state nondegeneracy
question: Determine whether the kernel of the constrained ground-state Hessian consists only of translation and phase symmetries.
first_test: Prove nondegeneracy in a fixed parameter regime or construct an extra neutral mode.

title: Binding at the critical mass
question: Determine whether the infimum at the first mass supporting a localized minimizer is attained or approached only by splitting sequences.
first_test: Prove attainment or explicit noncompactness at the endpoint.

title: Orbital stability from quantitative coercivity
question: Find a sharp modulus connecting mass-energy deficit to distance from the constrained minimizer orbit.
first_test: Prove a global or local stability inequality with the correct exponent.

title: Competing radial and stripe minimizers
question: Determine when radial localized states and periodically modulated states exchange energetic optimality under a fixed mass constraint.
first_test: Compare the branches rigorously and locate any crossing.

title: Mass partition in vector solitons
question: For a two-component focusing–defocusing energy, determine whether the minimizing mass allocation is unique under fixed total mass.
first_test: Prove a unique partition or construct symmetry-related distinct optima.

title: Concentration-compactness without radial symmetry
question: Establish a profile decomposition that tracks anisotropic translations and Fourier-shell concentration for minimizing sequences.
first_test: Prove an exact concentration alternative with mass and energy decoupling.

title: Barycentric pinning of minimizers
question: After fixing phase and center of mass, determine when the ground-state minimizing sequence becomes strongly compact without quotient ambiguity.
first_test: Prove a pinned compactness theorem or show residual loss of compactness.

title: Sharp strict-subadditivity transition
question: Locate changes from binding to nonbinding as a mass parameter crosses an explicitly defined threshold.
first_test: Prove strict inequalities on one side and equality sequences on the other.

title: Soliton branch turning-point stability
question: Determine whether a Vakhitov–Kolokolov-type slope condition predicts stability through a fold in the fourth-order model.
first_test: Derive an index-based criterion or construct a counterexample.

title: Constrained minimizers with angular momentum
question: At fixed mass and prescribed nonzero angular momentum, determine whether the energy infimum is attained by rotating coherent states.
first_test: Prove existence and orbital stability or nonattainment.

title: Energy landscape Morse index
question: Compute or bound the Morse index of excited stationary configurations in a finite-energy class.
first_test: Establish an index theorem and connect index changes to bifurcation.

title: Mountain-pass localized states
question: Determine whether the same energy admits nonminimizing localized critical points selected by a mountain-pass minimax level.
first_test: Prove a Palais–Smale condition or identify an obstruction.

title: Uniform minimizer bounds near zero dispersion
question: Determine the asymptotic profile of constrained minimizers as the coefficient of the fourth-order term tends to zero.
first_test: Prove rescaled convergence or loss of compactness.

title: Large-mass saturation profiles
question: Characterize the spatial scale and amplitude of minimizers as mass tends to infinity under quintic defocusing saturation.
first_test: Derive asymptotics and rule out competing shape families.

title: Variational gap under weak external fields
question: Bound how a weak localized potential shifts the energy difference between bound and separated soliton configurations.
first_test: Prove continuity and sharp first-order variation.

title: Multiplicity of symmetry-related local minima
question: Classify distinct local minimizer orbits under discrete rotational symmetry and determine which bifurcate as a control parameter changes.
first_test: Produce a complete local bifurcation and energy ordering.

title: Energy quantization in concentrating sequences
question: Determine whether a bounded sequence of nearly critical waves can concentrate into finitely many profiles with quantized positive energy.
first_test: Prove bubble energy decoupling or construct a diffuse counterexample.

title: Dynamical stability of constrained excited minima
question: Characterize when a constrained local minimum that is not the global minimum remains orbitally stable under the Hamiltonian flow.
first_test: Prove stability from a localized coercivity estimate or find unstable directions.
